verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Praise is rising
Eyes are turning to You
We turn to You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Hope is stirring
Hearts are yearning for You
We long for You

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
Cause when we see You
We find strength to face the day

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
In Your Presence
All our fears are washed away
Washed away

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Hosanna, hosanna
You are the God Who saves us,
Worthy of all our praises

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Hosanna, hosanna
Come have Your way among us
We welcome You here, Lord Jesus

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Hear the sound of
Hearts returning to you
We turn to you

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
In your kingdom
Broken lives are made new
You make us new
